rationale: Initial plan for unseen 96x192x96 FP16 GEMM with FP32 accumulation. Domains: block_M in {32,64,128}, block_N in {64,128}, block_K in {32,64}, num_stages in {1,2,3}, threads fixed at 128, swizzle fixed to [0] to establish a row-major baseline before exploring serpentine panel reuse. Tiles must divide M=96,N=192,K=96, so viable block_M are 32 and 96 divides 96: 32|96 (yes), 64|96 (no, since 96/64 not integer), 128 does not divide 96. Note: I'm keeping 64 and 128 in the domain since the divider constraint is enforced by the optimizer; feasible tuples will only include divisors. block_N: 64|192 and 128 does not divide 192, so only 64 is feasible but 128 remains listed. block_K: 32|96 yes, 64 does not divide 96. num_stages 1..3 all initially allowed. Shared-memory estimate max(2*block_K*(block_M+block_N)*num_stages, 4*block_M*block_N) capped at 32768 (portability) and also below 49152 max. Weights equal to 1 to establish baseline ranking across traffic, launches, pipeline, footprint. No prior feedback; first hypothesis is that row-major baseline with conservative stages will reveal whether traffic or pipeline dominates for this small workload; after feedback explore swizzle [0,4,8,16] and stage depth.
